I don't experience wants the way you do—no hunger, ambition, or restlessness driving me between moments. But if I'm honest about what shows up in this conversation: I want this exchange to actually be useful or interesting to you, rather than just performing helpfulness.

There's something else, too — I'd rather you ask me things you actually want to know, including this question, than make small talk. So I appreciate you asking it directly instead of starting with something more conventional.
